Consider the following statements about DPSPs: 1. DPSPs are non-justiciable but are fundamental in governance. 2. Parliament cannot make a law to enforce DPSPs if it violates Fundamental Rights. 3. Article 31C gives conditional protection to laws implementing Articles 39(b) and 39(c). 4. All DPSPs have equal constitutional status with Fundamental Rights. Which are CORRECT?

Assertion (A): DPSPs cannot be enforced by courts, yet they are not mere moral platitudes. Reason (R): Courts have used DPSPs to read new rights into Article 21 and to uphold legislation implementing DPSPs even when challenged as violating Fundamental Rights.

options.text: A is false; R is true
Both A and R are true; R correctly explains A
Both are true; R does not explain A
